cues.en: In this video, I'm going to show you how to work with OLAMA, meaning the offline system that you can put on your machine
cues.zh: 這支影片會示範如何使用 Ollama，也就是可以安裝在自己電腦上的離線系統，

cues.en: and run offline models if you have good enough graphic drivers.
cues.zh: 只要顯示硬體效能足夠，就能執行離線模型。

cues.en: So up on olama.com, you simply go and download, and in here you choose your system, in my case Windows.
cues.zh: 前往 ollama.com，直接選擇下載，再選擇作業系統，我這裡是 Windows。

cues.en: It downloads a fairly big file and it installs OLAMA, and once you have that, you end up with this little desktop app
cues.zh: 它會下載一個不小的檔案並安裝 Ollama。安裝完成後，會看到這個小型桌面應用程式，

cues.en: where you can chat as various launch agents for other tools and a few settings.
cues.zh: 可以進行對話、為其他工具啟動代理程式，並調整一些設定。

cues.en: So in order to get the different models, you can go to the models library here and search for various models.
cues.zh: 要取得不同模型，可以到這裡的模型資料庫搜尋。

cues.en: I have a very small machine, so I cannot run the big models, so I've just chosen a very old one here that is only 1.3 gigabytes or 2.0, I'm using the latest.
cues.zh: 我的電腦效能有限，無法執行大型模型，因此選了一個很舊、只有約 1.3 GB 或 2 GB 的模型，這裡使用 latest 版本。

cues.en: And all you need to do in order to get the model is you go into a new chat, search for the model,
cues.zh: 想取得模型，只要開啟新對話，搜尋模型，

cues.en: and once you send your first message, it will download it on the fly.
cues.zh: 送出第一則訊息時，就會自動下載。

cues.en: I've already downloaded and I just said hello.
cues.zh: 我已經下載完成，並說了一聲你好。

cues.en: What models to choose is up to you.
cues.zh: 要選哪個模型，由你自行決定。

cues.en: There's a bunch of models that are supported up here, and they just list them.
cues.zh: 這裡支援許多模型，網站上都有列出。

cues.en: Again, I cannot test many of them because my machine simply don't have enough graphic power to do that.
cues.zh: 同樣地，我無法測試其中很多模型，因為電腦的顯示運算能力不足。

cues.en: In OLAMA, they also have a cloud version, a little like going to Azure OpenAI or the systems in order to run.
cues.zh: Ollama 也提供雲端版本，有點像 Azure OpenAI 等服務，讓你執行，

cues.en: The ones you might not be able to run yourself, but you need to sign in, and that's not what this video is about.
cues.zh: 自己電腦可能無法負荷的模型。不過需要登入，而且不是這支影片的主題。

cues.en: If you want to learn more about each model, you can go to Hugging Face and read about the models.
cues.zh: 如果想進一步了解個別模型，可以到 Hugging Face 閱讀模型介紹。

cues.en: But I can't choose for you what model to run.
cues.zh: 但我無法替你決定該執行哪一個模型。

cues.en: It mostly often depends on how much graphic memory you have.
cues.zh: 通常主要取決於你有多少顯示記憶體。

cues.en: Bigger models are, of course, better, but they're nowhere near the state-of-the-art models
cues.zh: 較大的模型當然通常更好，但和雲端最頂尖的模型，

cues.en: up in the cloud like GPT 55 and Opus 4.8.
cues.zh: 例如 GPT-5.5、Opus 4.8 等，仍然有一段差距。

cues.en: But you go and grab your model, but now you have just this tool, and of course, we are 18 frameworks, so we want to be able to use it together with that.
cues.zh: 下載模型後，目前只有這個工具。當然，這是 Agent Framework 課程，所以我們希望能把它整合進框架。

cues.en: In order to do that, we need to find where this service is running, what local port it's running on.
cues.zh: 為了做到這點，需要知道服務在哪裡執行，也就是本機使用哪個連接埠。

cues.en: If we go to their documentation, so Docs here, let me try to do it, and search for port.
cues.zh: 前往官方文件，也就是這裡的 Docs，搜尋 port。

cues.en: That's the easiest way to do it.
cues.zh: 這是最簡單的查找方式。

cues.en: We can just go here, and we can see that it's localhost, port 11434 by default, something you can change.
cues.zh: 在這裡可以看到，預設是 localhost，連接埠 11434。這個值也可以修改。

cues.en: But I don't normally change this.
cues.zh: 但我通常不會修改。

cues.en: Another way you can do it is in your taskbar.
cues.zh: 另一種方式，是從工作列查看。

cues.en: I don't show that on the screen right now.
cues.zh: 目前畫面沒有顯示工作列。

cues.en: They have a small icon like many other tools.
cues.zh: 它和其他工具一樣，會有一個小圖示。

cues.en: And in that, you can go in and view the logs with this in your AppData local OLAMA.
cues.zh: 從圖示可以開啟記錄檔，位置在 AppData／Local／Ollama。

cues.en: And in here, you can often see where it is, either here or in the AppLog.
cues.zh: 在這裡通常能找到服務位置，可能在這個檔案，或 AppLog 中。

cues.en: In my case, I think it's in the AppLog, where we should be able to see a localhost.
cues.zh: 我這個例子應該在 AppLog，可以找到 localhost。

cues.en: And what was it? 1143.
cues.zh: 剛剛是多少？11434。

cues.en: Here we can see there's a target here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到目標位址。

cues.en: But if you don't change anything, it will be this.
cues.zh: 但只要沒有修改設定，通常就是這個預設值。

cues.en: And in 18 Framework, I have a small sample here, under section 9 to 17, OLAMA here.
cues.zh: 在 Agent Framework 範例中，這裡有一個 Ollama 小範例，位於對應章節底下。

cues.en: And in order to do this, we of course need the 18 Framework, but we also need a NuGet package that can work with OLAMA.
cues.zh: 為了使用它，當然需要 Agent Framework，也需要能與 Ollama 溝通的 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And that NuGet package is called...
cues.zh: 這個 NuGet 套件叫做……

cues.en: Let me stop this code so we can see it.
cues.zh: 先停止程式，讓我們查看。

cues.en: So in the installed, we'll be able to see that we have an OLAMA sharp.
cues.zh: 在已安裝套件中，可以看到 OllamaSharp。

cues.en: So OLAMA for C-sharp.
cues.zh: 也就是 C# 使用的 Ollama 套件。

cues.en: So that's just an open source NuGet package made by third parties.
cues.zh: 這是第三方製作的開放原始碼 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And once we have that, it is as simple as what we normally do, except that when we need an iChat client,
cues.zh: 安裝後，做法和平常一樣簡單，只是在需要 IChatClient 的地方，

cues.en: we get an OLAMA API client instead.
cues.zh: 改成建立 OllamaApiClient。

cues.en: And for that, we need to give the endpoint.
cues.zh: 建立時需要提供端點。

cues.en: So that would be our localhost and the default port.
cues.zh: 也就是 localhost 加上預設連接埠。

cues.en: And we need to give the name of the model, just as we downloaded in the app.
cues.zh: 另外要提供模型名稱，和剛剛在 App 中下載的名稱一致。

cues.en: We don't need any passwords or anything.
cues.zh: 不需要任何密碼或其他認證。

cues.en: There is no password because it's local, of course.
cues.zh: 因為在本機執行，所以這裡沒有設定密碼。

cues.en: And once we have this client, we can just make a chat client agent, giving in the iChat client.
cues.zh: 取得用戶端後，直接把這個 IChatClient 傳給 ChatClientAgent，建立代理程式。

cues.en: And beyond that, it is just as normal.
cues.zh: 除此之外，一切和平常相同。

cues.en: And let me put this up here so we can see it side by side when it's running.
cues.zh: 把程式移到這裡，執行時就能並排觀察。

cues.en: So I'm just going to run this, set the model, set the endpoint, create my client and my agent, and then just normal agent.runAsync
cues.zh: 現在執行，設定模型與端點、建立用戶端和代理程式，接著正常呼叫 agent.RunAsync，

cues.en: towards the capital of Sweden.
cues.zh: 詢問瑞典的首都。

cues.en: And it will be quite slow because it's not my machine that can handle these.
cues.zh: 執行會比較慢，因為我的電腦不太能負荷這些模型。

cues.en: But it comes back and says the capital of Sweden is stuck on.
cues.zh: 不過最後會回覆，瑞典的首都是斯德哥爾摩。

cues.en: And then we can do streaming, of course.
cues.zh: 當然也可以使用串流。

cues.en: Not every single offline model that can do tool calling, structured output, and so on, that's on a model-by-model basis that you need to check out what they can do.
cues.zh: 不是每個離線模型都支援工具呼叫、結構化輸出等功能，必須逐一檢查模型具備哪些能力。

cues.en: In general, I don't use offline models, really.
cues.zh: 整體來說，我自己其實不太使用離線模型。

cues.en: I tend to go with the online models, mostly because of my machine, but also I just want the best models out there.
cues.zh: 我通常選擇線上模型，主要是電腦效能限制，也因為我想使用目前最好的模型。

cues.en: And these offline models, while free-slash-cheap, because you still need to pay for the power,
cues.zh: 這些離線模型雖然免費或便宜，當然還是要支付電費，

cues.en: they tend to not be as good as the models we have seen in the rest of this lecture.
cues.zh: 但能力通常不如本課程其他部分使用的模型。

cues.en: So that's everything on how you do anything with Olama.
cues.zh: 以上就是使用 Ollama 的方式。
